vision.name: Black Android Visage
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(Villains only.)
POWER: Banish the top 5 cards of your opponent's discard pile. If there are no cards in your opponent's discard pile, discard a card from your opponent's hand. [Trait:Android]: If your opponent has not discarded a card this action, discard a card from your opponent's hand.
(Rejuvenate after use.)
